title: Compare Titanic group rules on authorized private data
summary: Blocked actual-data candidate: compare the same two group rules on five unchanged stratified folds. Authorized Titanic inputs and a successful reviewed actual-data receipt are still missing.
split_definition: Five target-stratified folds with seed 17; each row validates once; group rules fit training rows only.
environment: Declared target: Python 3.12.14 standard library on Darwin arm64; no actual Titanic run recorded. Set private input/output environment variables as documented before execution.
steps: Inspect current official data access and rules, obtain authorized private training data yourself, and keep it outside Git/public/dist.
Use the pinned four-file package and private environment variables; run both configurations on the same five seed-17 stratified folds.
Inspect per-fold differences, safe aggregated error slices and limitations; retain worse results.
Compare notebook and runner metrics exactly, inspect safe-review candidates, and validate optional submission locally without publishing or uploading it.
limitations: No actual Titanic data has been supplied or run; software tests use generated rows only.
Random stratification does not isolate passenger families or tickets.
Accuracy is the unweighted mean of folds, not the hidden competition test score.
Traced Python allocations are not process RSS; no learner compute budget has been measured.
Fingerprint consistency does not authenticate dataset origin or authorization.

project.outcome: Explain a controlled group-rule comparison using fixed train-only validation and aggregated diagnostics.
prerequisites: Run a local Python script and set private environment variables.
Explain a binary target, accuracy and a training/validation split.

access.instructions: Inspect https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/titanic/data and current rules yourself; obtain authorized train.csv and optional test.csv privately. Follow docs/titanic-actual-data-setup.md; no automatic acquisition or submission.
access.authorization: Missing: no authorized learner-supplied competition inputs or access evidence received.

project.baseline: Fit sex-majority using training rows only on the fixed five stratified folds.
project.controlled_change: Compare sex-class-majority on exactly the same folds; retain worse outcomes.
diagnostics: Do the two methods agree in direction across all five unchanged folds?
Which sufficiently large sex/class slices have more errors, and what does the split omit?

troubleshooting.symptom: Missing authorized data or access failure
troubleshooting.recovery: Retain blocked status; the owner must supply private authorized paths and inspect access conditions before running.
Use the setup recovery table, restore pinned files and rerun into a new private output directory; never publish raw errors or inputs.
